The consumer price index (CPI) increased 0.1% in July, compared with a fall of 0.4% in June,  according to the latest report from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. The year-over-year increase was 3.4%, down from 3.5% in June. The core CPI, excluding food and energy, was up 2.5% from a year ago, compared to 2.6% for the year ending in June.
